Initially, I was told that delivery had been confirmed.

I repeatedly provided this evidence to customer service and asked that it be reviewed as part of a meaningful investigation.

As a customer, my expectation is simple: either deliver the correct item and quantity ordered or issue a refund when that does not happen.
